captions.detailed: A teaching-lab monocular microscope featuring a wide, rounded rectangular foot base, a straight vertical support arm, a monocular eyepiece tube angled upwards, and a black square stage mounted on a slide block. The assembly uses a light-gray color for the structural base, arm, and eyepiece tube, while the specimen stage, objective turret, and eyepiece rim are colored dark gray/black. Articulations include a prismatic joint allowing the stage block to slide vertically, a revolute joint for rotating the objective turret, and a revolute control knob on the side of the slide block.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery model of a teaching-lab monocular microscope. The model should include a wide rounded base, a straight vertical arm, an angled monocular tube, and a dark square stage. Incorporate articulations for a vertically sliding stage block, a rotating objective turret, and a rotating stage-control knob.
captions.factory: Construct the microscope's base by extruding a rounded rectangle, and attach a vertical rectangular column for the arm. Create the monocular eyepiece assembly using angled cylinder primitives combined with a dark-colored eyepiece rim. Model the specimen stage as a thin square box with a central aperture, mounted on a slide block. Define a prismatic joint for the vertical movement of the stage block relative to the arm, a revolute joint for the objective turret beneath the arm's overhang, and a revolute joint for the side-mounted adjustment knob.
